onboarding.emptyCatalog.title: No exercises to work with
onboarding.emptyCatalog.message: The exercise library came back empty, so there is nothing to build a program from yet. Try loading it again.
onboarding.action.hint: Saves this step and moves on
onboarding.chip.locked: Already ruled out by one of your limitations
onboarding.step.welcome.title: Welcome to Forge
onboarding.step.welcome.subtitle: A few questions, and you will have a program built around your week.
onboarding.step.basics.title: About you
onboarding.step.basics.subtitle: The numbers your energy target and your starting loads are built on.
onboarding.step.goals.title: What you are training for
onboarding.step.goals.subtitle: The first goal you pick leads. The rest shade the choices around it.
onboarding.step.experience.title: Your background
onboarding.step.experience.subtitle: This sets how hard and how varied your first block is.
onboarding.step.availability.title: Your week
onboarding.step.availability.subtitle: How often you can train, and how long you have each time.
onboarding.step.equipment.title: What you train with
onboarding.step.equipment.subtitle: Only exercises you can actually load will be suggested.
onboarding.step.restrictions.title: Anything to avoid
onboarding.step.restrictions.subtitle: Optional. Movements and exercises you would rather never see.
onboarding.step.nutrition.title: Food
onboarding.step.nutrition.subtitle: Optional. Turn it off and the nutrition tab stays out of your way.
onboarding.step.generating.title: Building your program
onboarding.step.generating.subtitle: Volume, then a split, then the exercises, then your targets.
onboarding.step.summary.title: Check it over
onboarding.step.summary.subtitle: Everything you told us. Change anything before you start.
onboarding.welcome.program.title: A program that fits your week
onboarding.welcome.program.detail: Built from the days you have, the time you have and the equipment you can reach.
onboarding.welcome.progress.title: Progress you can see
onboarding.welcome.progress.detail: Every set is logged, and your loads move as your numbers do.
onboarding.welcome.explain.title: Reasons, not just numbers
onboarding.welcome.explain.detail: Every suggestion comes with the thinking behind it, so you can overrule it.
onboarding.welcome.privacy.title: Your data stays on your phone
onboarding.welcome.privacy.detail: No account, no sign-in, nothing sent anywhere.
onboarding.welcome.time: About five minutes, and %lld exercises to draw from.
onboarding.basics.units.detail: Everything below is entered and shown in these.
onboarding.basics.name: Your name
onboarding.basics.name.detail: Optional. Only used to greet you.
onboarding.basics.birthDate.detail: Age changes your estimated energy needs.
onboarding.basics.birthDate.skipped: Without it, your energy estimate assumes an average adult age.
onboarding.basics.sex.detail: Used only by the equation that estimates your energy needs.
onboarding.basics.sex.unspecified.detail: Your estimate will sit between the two figures.
onboarding.basics.body.detail: The base for your energy target and your first working loads.
onboarding.basics.target.detail: Optional. It sets the direction of your energy target, nothing else.
onboarding.basics.target.same: That matches your current weight, so your target will sit at maintenance.
onboarding.basics.target.lose: %@ to lose. Your energy target will sit below maintenance.
onboarding.basics.target.gain: %@ to gain. Your energy target will sit above maintenance.
onboarding.hint.age: Choose a date of birth between %lld and %lld years ago.
onboarding.hint.priorityRequired: Pick at least one muscle group or area to focus on.
onboarding.hint.daysEmpty: Pick at least one day you can train.
onboarding.hint.sessionMinutes: A session can be %lld to %lld minutes long.
onboarding.hint.equipmentEmpty: Pick at least one piece of equipment.
onboarding.hint.platesEmpty: Pick the plates your gym stocks.
onboarding.hint.mealsPerDay: Choose between %lld and %lld meals a day.
onboarding.hint.budget: Enter a weekly food budget above zero.
onboarding.goals.title: Your goals
onboarding.goals.detail: Pick up to four. The first one you choose leads.
onboarding.goals.limit: Four goals is the most a single program can serve well.
onboarding.goals.regions.detail: Optional. A quick way to prioritise several muscle groups at once.
onboarding.goals.muscles.detail: Optional. These get the extra sets when there is room for them.
onboarding.goals.muscles.required: Pick at least one — you chose to focus on a muscle group.
onboarding.goals.muscles.limit: Four is the most that can get meaningful extra volume.
onboarding.goals.muscles.summary: Extra sets go to %lld of your muscle groups first.
onboarding.experience.level.detail: This caps how demanding the exercises you are offered can be.
onboarding.experience.months.detail: Roughly how long you have been training consistently.
onboarding.experience.technique.detail: How sure you are of your form on the main lifts.
onboarding.experience.seeds.detail: Optional. A weight and a rep count for any lift you know sets a sensible starting load.
onboarding.experience.seeds.partial: Fill in only the lifts you know. The rest are estimated from your first working sets.
onboarding.availability.days.detail: How many days a week you can realistically train.
onboarding.availability.days.summary: Days a week: %lld — spaced out to leave recovery between sessions.
onboarding.availability.length.detail: The most time you have in one session, rest between sets included.
onboarding.availability.length.short: Short sessions work well. Expect fewer exercises in each one.
onboarding.availability.time.detail: Decides when a reminder would land, if you turn reminders on.
onboarding.availability.cardio.detail: Whether conditioning goes with your lifting or on its own.
onboarding.availability.activity.detail: Life outside the gym. It moves your energy estimate more than training does.
onboarding.equipment.preset.detail: Start from a setup, then fine-tune it below.
onboarding.equipment.fineTune.detail: Tick everything you can reach, and untick anything you cannot.
onboarding.equipment.empty.title: No equipment to list
onboarding.equipment.empty.message: The exercise library has not finished loading, so there is nothing to choose from yet.
onboarding.equipment.bodyweightLocked: Bodyweight stays on. It is the one thing you always have.
onboarding.equipment.increments.detail: So every weight suggested is one your gym can actually make.
onboarding.equipment.plates.detail: Barbell suggestions are rounded to what these plates can build.
onboarding.restrictions.limitations.deta: Optional. Anything picked here is left out of your program. This is a preference, not a diagnosis.
onboarding.restrictions.patterns.detail: Optional. Whole patterns you would rather never be given.
onboarding.restrictions.patterns.implied: Your answers above already rule out %lld of these.
onboarding.restrictions.exclusions.detai: Optional. Search for anything you would rather not be given.
onboarding.restrictions.exclusions.add: Adds this exercise to your excluded list
onboarding.restrictions.exclusions.remov: Removes this exercise from your excluded list
onboarding.restrictions.search.hint: Type at least two letters to search the library.
onboarding.restrictions.search.empty.mes: Nothing in the library matches “%@”. Try a shorter word.
onboarding.nutrition.enable.detail: Counting food suits some people and not others. Your call.
onboarding.nutrition.enable.toggle: Track food and set a daily target
onboarding.nutrition.enable.off: No daily target will be set and the nutrition tab stays hidden. You can turn it on later in Settings.
onboarding.nutrition.diet.detail: Filters what the app will ever suggest.
onboarding.nutrition.allergens.detail: Nothing carrying these tags is ever suggested.
onboarding.nutrition.intolerances.detail: Treated exactly like an allergy: left out entirely.
onboarding.nutrition.excluded.detail: Anything you would rather not be offered.
onboarding.nutrition.excluded.add: Add a food to leave out
onboarding.nutrition.excluded.hint: One word works best. These match ingredient tags rather than dish names.
onboarding.nutrition.meals.detail: How your daily target is divided up.
onboarding.nutrition.meals.fourPlus: Your protein gets spread more evenly across the day.
onboarding.nutrition.meals.three: Fewer, larger meals, so protein per meal will be higher.
onboarding.nutrition.pace.detail: How quickly your weight moves towards your target.
onboarding.nutrition.pace.generic: Add your weight to see this as a weekly figure.
onboarding.nutrition.budget.detail: Optional. Cheaper suggestions are preferred when you set one.
onboarding.nutrition.budget.toggle: Keep my shopping within a budget
onboarding.nutrition.budget.currency: In your own currency. It is only ever compared against itself.
onboarding.generate.stage.split: Choosing a split for your week
onboarding.generate.stage.fitting: Fitting each session to your time
onboarding.generate.patience: This takes a moment. Every exercise in the library is scored against your answers.
onboarding.generate.waiting: Available once your program is ready
onboarding.generate.error.catalog: The exercise library is empty, so a program cannot be built.
onboarding.generate.error.empty: Your equipment and the movements you ruled out leave nothing to program. Add some equipment, or remove an exclusion, and try again.
onboarding.generate.manual.detail: You get an empty week with the right number of days, ready to fill in whenever you like.
onboarding.generate.manualExplanation: You are building this program yourself, so there is nothing for the app to explain yet. Add exercises to each day whenever you are ready.
onboarding.program.title: Your %@ program
onboarding.result.week.detail: One week of the plan. All of it can be changed later.
onboarding.result.volume.detail: Hard sets per muscle group across the week.
onboarding.result.volume.empty.title: Nothing to show yet
onboarding.result.volume.empty.message: This program has no sets assigned to a muscle group.
onboarding.result.why.empty.title: No notes this time
onboarding.result.why.empty.message: Nothing about this program needed explaining.
onboarding.result.nutrition.detail: A starting point. It adjusts as your weight trend moves.
onboarding.result.maintenance: Your maintenance is estimated at around %@ a day.
onboarding.result.nutrition.off.title: Food tracking is off
onboarding.result.nutrition.off.message: No daily target was set. You can turn tracking on in Settings whenever you want one.
onboarding.summary.program.empty.title: No program yet
onboarding.summary.program.empty.message: Your answers are saved, but nothing has been built from them yet.
onboarding.summary.nutritionOff: No daily target is set, so the nutrition tab stays hidden.
onboarding.summary.ready.title: Ready when you are
onboarding.summary.ready.detail: Confirming saves these answers, makes this your active program and opens the app. Anything here can be changed later in Settings.
onboarding.summary.ready.privacy: It all stays on this phone.
onboarding.summary.confirm.hint: Finishes setup and opens the app
